_comment: Machine-independent inventory of what the project needs. scripts/dm_link.py materialises data/, checkpoints/ and outputs/ on each machine from the 'hosts' block; keys starting with '_' are documentation and are skipped.

bedlam.role: synthetic source archives (png, depth, masks, gt)

sloper4d.role: real: LiDAR + RGB + SMPL + calibration, secondary target

lidarhuman26m.role: real: images + human LiDAR + SMPL (dropped from the paper)

waymo_perception.role: real: v2 parquet (images, lidar, calibration, keypoints)

waymo_extracted.role: real: per-object keypoints + pedestrian LiDAR crops, primary target

body_models.role: SMPL / SMPL-X model files (licensed, never committed)

generated.role: our shards, tokens, extracted BEDLAM frames and converted body models

methods._comment: git submodules under third_party/, evaluated as baselines

smoke.command: uv run torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node 1 main.py --config configs/smoke.yaml --wandb-project lidar-bedlam --wandb-name smoke-local --wandb-mode offline
